identification: Cased carved meerschaum pipe, late 19th/early 20th century, a galloping horse in relief along the bowl with a second horse figure behind it (photo 3 shows two horses, one rearing over the other), amber-coloured (probably amber or amber-type) mouthpiece collar with a cork-lined cap, white-metal ferrule, black vulcanite-style stem, in a fitted dark green leather case lined red velvet and ivory satin (case worn, scuffed). Case label 5810/3 is the consignor's tag.
